questions.prompt: A fraud model has `99.4%` accuracy in production, yet customers complain fraud is slipping through. What should you inspect first?

options.text: Precision, recall, PR-AUC, and confusion matrix on the minority fraud class — accuracy is dominated by non-fraud

questions.prompt: In production, a churn model trained on historical data suddenly drops in accuracy after a pricing change. What happened?

options.text: Concept/covariate drift — the relationship between features and churn shifted after the pricing change

questions.prompt: Match each production ML failure mode to its primary safeguard.

columns.label: Shared feature-transform pipeline / feature store used identically in training and inference
Strict point-in-time feature joins excluding post-outcome attributes
Automated distribution checks (PSI/KS) and live outcome monitoring

questions.prompt: Why is **point-in-time correctness** critical when joining historical feature tables for training?

options.text: To avoid joining future feature updates (recorded after the label event) into past training examples

questions.prompt: Which practices ensure **reproducible ML pipelines** in engineering teams? (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Versioning code, dataset snapshots/hashes, and environment dependencies together
Logging hyperparameters, metrics, and random seeds per run
Wrapping preprocessing + model in a single serialized pipeline artifact
Manually editing CSVs in Excel without recording changes

questions.prompt: Your model predicts loan approval and shows `92%` recall for Group A but `65%` recall for Group B. What is this an example of?

options.text: Disparate performance / fairness gap across subgroups requiring audit of data representation and thresholds

questions.prompt: Why can simply **dropping a protected attribute** (like gender or race) fail to remove model bias?

options.text: Correlated proxy features (zip code, school, browsing patterns) can still reconstruct the protected attribute

questions.prompt: When deploying a **real-time** recommendation model with a `20ms` p99 latency SLA, which trade-off matters most?

options.text: Inference complexity, feature-lookup latency, and model size (quantization/distillation vs. giant ensembles)

questions.prompt: What is **shadow deployment** (dark launch) for a new ML model?

options.text: Running the new model on live production traffic in parallel without exposing its predictions to users, to compare latency and outputs safely

questions.prompt: Which checks belong in a **pre-deploy ML model gate**? (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Subgroup fairness and slice regression checks
Inference latency and memory footprint benchmark
Skipping schema validation on inference inputs
Minimum performance threshold vs. current production baseline on a golden test set

questions.prompt: Why is **batch inference** often preferred over **real-time online inference** when predictions don't depend on sub-second context?

options.text: Batch jobs run offline on schedules, precompute results into a fast store, and avoid live serving latency/availability risk

questions.prompt: What is **feature store**'s main architectural value in an organization with multiple ML services?

options.text: Providing consistent, point-in-time offline training features and low-latency online serving from shared definitions

questions.prompt: Match each bias/variance symptom to the right engineering remedy.

columns.label: More training data, stronger regularization, simpler model, or feature selection
Richer features, higher model capacity, or reduced regularization
Class weighting, threshold tuning, and PR-AUC evaluation

questions.prompt: In **active learning**, how do teams reduce labeling costs?

options.text: Prioritizing human labeling on the most uncertain or informative unlabeled examples

questions.prompt: What is **threshold tuning** in binary classification?

options.text: Changing `0.5` cutoff to optimize business cost (e.g., `0.2` when missing fraud costs 10x a manual review)

questions.prompt: Which practices protect **privacy** when training models on user data? (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Applying differential privacy or aggregation where appropriate
Logging raw user emails inside model prediction traces

questions.prompt: What is **knowledge distillation**?

options.text: Training a small, fast student model to mimic the soft probability outputs of a large teacher model

questions.prompt: Why can **feedback loops** corrupt a deployed ranking or fraud model?

options.text: The model only observes outcomes on items it chose to show/approve, biasing future training data toward its own past decisions

questions.prompt: What is **SHAP** (SHapley Additive exPlanations) used for?

options.text: Attributing each feature's contribution to an individual prediction based on cooperative game theory

questions.prompt: When is **causal inference** (uplift modeling / experiments) needed instead of standard predictive ML?

options.text: When deciding *who to intervene on* (e.g., which customer gets a discount) where correlation cannot separate natural buyers from persuadables

questions.prompt: Which signals should an **ML observability** dashboard track? (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Input feature null rates and out-of-range spikes
Prediction distribution shifts (e.g., sudden jump in positive rate)

questions.prompt: What is **quantization** (e.g., FP32 -> INT8) in deep learning deployment?

options.text: Representing weights/activations with lower-precision integers to shrink memory and speed up inference

questions.prompt: Why should **synthetic data** or **data augmentation** be applied *only* to training folds, never validation/test folds?

options.text: Validation/test must reflect real-world unseen distributions, not artificially generated samples

questions.prompt: In **k-fold cross-validation** with grouped entities (e.g., multiple visits per patient), why must you use `GroupKFold`?

options.text: To keep all records of the same patient in either train or val, preventing entity-level leakage

code.source:
gkf = GroupKFold(n_splits=5)
for tr, va in gkf.split(X, y, groups=patient_id): ...

questions.prompt: Match each rollout strategy to its primary purpose.

columns.label: Limits blast radius while checking live latency and errors on real users
Compares new model outputs/latency offline against prod with zero user impact
Statistically measures downstream business KPI lift vs. control

questions.prompt: What is **catastrophic forgetting** when fine-tuning a neural network on a new task?

options.text: The network overwrites weights needed for earlier tasks unless replay or parameter-efficient tuning is used
The disk runs out of space

questions.prompt: Why do **tree-based models** (XGBoost, LightGBM) still dominate many tabular ML tasks over deep neural networks?

options.text: They handle mixed numeric/categorical splits, missing values, and non-smooth tabular boundaries with less tuning

questions.prompt: What does **hallucination** refer to in generative / LLM systems?

options.text: Confident generation of factually false, ungrounded, or fabricated statements

questions.prompt: What is **prompt injection** in LLM-integrated applications?

options.text: Untrusted user or retrieved text overriding system instructions to exfiltrate data or trigger unintended tool calls

questions.prompt: Which safeguards reduce risk in **production LLM applications**? (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Grounding answers in verified retrieved documents with citations
Validating structured outputs against a strict JSON schema
Executing arbitrary model-generated SQL directly as superuser

questions.prompt: Why is **embedding similarity** (cosine similarity) used in semantic search?

options.text: It matches exact character ASCII codes only
It measures semantic proximity between dense vector representations of queries and documents

questions.prompt: What is the **cold-start problem** in recommender systems?

options.text: Lack of interaction history for new users or new items, requiring content features or popularity fallbacks

questions.prompt: What is **label noise** and how does it affect supervised models?

options.text: Incorrect or inconsistent ground-truth labels that cap achievable accuracy and mislead complex models

questions.prompt: What does `model.eval()` followed by `with torch.no_grad():` do during PyTorch inference?

options.text: Sets eval behavior for dropout/batchnorm and disables autograd tracking to save memory and time

questions.prompt: Why should **human-in-the-loop (HITL)** review be kept for low-confidence or high-impact ML decisions?

options.text: To route uncertain edge cases to domain experts and feed corrections back into training

questions.prompt: What is **early-stage data validation** with Pandera or Great Expectations?

options.text: Declaratively asserting column types, nullability, ranges, and uniqueness before training or scoring

questions.prompt: Which metrics help detect **covariate/data drift** between training and production? (Select all that apply.)

options.text: JS / KL divergence on categorical distributions

questions.prompt: Why is **feature importance** on correlated features tricky to interpret in tree or linear models?

options.text: Importance splits arbitrarily across correlated twins, making each look less important than the pair

questions.prompt: What is **canary rollback** automation?

options.text: Automatically reverting traffic to the previous stable model if latency, error rate, or drift alarms fire

questions.prompt: In **model cards** (documentation for ML models), what should always be recorded?

options.text: Intended use, training data scope, evaluation metrics by slice, known limitations, and ethical considerations

questions.prompt: When should you **retrain** a production model?

options.text: On a validated cadence or when drift/performance monitors show degradation, gated by offline evaluation

questions.prompt: What defines a **mature ML engineering** workflow?

options.text: Versioned data/code, leak-free pipelines, slice/fairness evaluation, safe rollouts, and continuous drift monitoring
